subject: PO field constraints and tiered volume clarification
messages:
From: Ellen Parker <ellen.parker@novacorp.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novacorp.com, mark.davis@novacorp.com
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor PO requirements + question on tiered discount buckets

Hi Hannah / Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — NovaCorp is excited about Redwood's inference latency guarantees. Procurement asked me to confirm a few things before we issue a PO:

1) PO format: they require a PO number field, vendor tax ID, and a GL code mapping column on the invoice to match our ERP. Can you confirm Redwood's invoice will include those fields?

2) Net terms: standard ask is net45, but finance prefers net30 for initial pilot. Is Redwood able to accept net45 and give a 3% early-pay discount if we pay within 15 days?

3) Invoice cadence: they prefer quarterly statements with individual invoices per PO line item (we have three distinct projects that need separate line items). Is splitting across multiple invoices per quarter supported?

4) Tiered volume discounts: procurement wants to map monthly usage buckets to three discount tiers (0-100k tokens: 0% / 100k-500k: 8% / >500k: 14%). We need confirmation these can be applied retroactively for the quarter.

I've attached NovaCorp's PO template for reference. Please send a short note on what you can accept and any gaps so we can align with our internal legal.

Best,
Ellen Parker
Senior Procurement Manager
NovaCorp

Attachment: NovaCorp_PO_Template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: Ellen Parker <ellen.parker@novacorp.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor PO requirements + question on tiered discount buckets

Ellen — thanks for the clear list and the template. Quick answers below; I've looped in Karthik (sales ops) and Vanessa (acct lead) for details and pricing matrix.

1) PO fields: We can populate PO number, vendor tax ID, and GL code on the invoice PDF and as discrete metadata in our billing feed. We'll attach the invoice with those fields visible and also send a CSV export for ERP ingestion.

2) Net terms / early-pay: Our standard commercial terms are net30 for pilot customers. We can do net45 only with a short-term credit hold; for the early-pay discount, we can offer 2.5% within 15 days (not 3%) due to existing banking fees. If NovaCorp can commit to quarterly minimums, we can revisit to 3%.

3) Invoice cadence: We support both quarterly statements and per-PO-line invoices. We can emit separate invoices per PO line under the same statement.

4) Tiered discounts: We can apply the tiers prospectively for the quarter. Retroactive application is possible but requires a manual true-up and approval from Finance (adds ~10 business days to process). We usually handle retroactive true-ups on a net basis at quarter close.

I'll attach our PO template and a simple pricing_matrix.csv that maps the three tiers to SKU IDs. Vanessa and I will follow up with a proposed mutual action plan for sign-off.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Template.pdf, pricing_matrix.csv
From: Mark Davis <mark.davis@novacorp.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Ellen Parker <ellen.parker@novacorp.com>, procurement@novacorp.com
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor PO requirements + question on tiered discount buckets

Hannah — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifying points from finance/legal:

- Retroactive true-ups are acceptable if Redwood can provide an itemized token usage export and a reconciled credit note per invoice line. Can your billing feed provide daily token-level CSVs for the quarter?

- For the early-pay discount, NovaCorp can accept 2.5% if the discount is applied as a line-item credit on the invoice rather than a separate remittance process.

- Regarding PO fields: the GL code is mandatory on the invoice XML (we have an automated processor). Can Redwood provide the GL mapping in a machine-readable field (CSV or XML) attached to the invoice?

We'll aim to get you a draft PO next week if we can confirm the above.

Thanks,
Mark Davis
Director, Finance Systems
NovaCorp

Hi Ellen / Mark — quick follow-up from Sales Ops with concrete artifacts so procurement can approve.

Attached: Redwood_PO_Template.pdf (fills NovaCorp fields), pricing_matrix.csv (SKU -> tier mapping), SOW_Redwood-Nova_v3.docx (scope, milestones).

Answers to your asks:
- Daily usage export: yes — we can provide daily token CSVs (machine-readable) for the quarter with token counts by SKU ID. We'll deliver via secure S3 link after contract signature.
- GL code: we'll include a machine-readable CSV with a GL column attached to each invoice file.
- Early-pay: we'll represent the 2.5% early-pay discount as a line-item credit; it will auto-calc when payment terms are set to 'earlypay-15d' in our billing system.
- Retroactive true-up: Redwood will run a quarterly true-up job and issue net credit notes per PO line. Please allow 10 business days after quarter close for processing.

Next step: If these artifacts look good, can NovaCorp send a signed PO referencing DEAL-99817 and indicate which PO number & GL codes you will use for each line? We'll then provision billing metadata matching your ERP.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
